newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA SET TO PLAY PANDURU IN PLACE OF INJURED SABAU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA SET TO PLAY PANDURU IN PLACE OF INJURED SABAU.

text.p: Romanian midfielder Ovidiu Sabau will miss Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Iceland in Reykjavik and will be replaced by Basarab Panduru, coach Anghel Iordanescu said on Monday.
"Sabau has a pulled muscle. We had to call up Panduru to replace him," Iordanescu said by telephone minutes before the team's departure to Reykjavik.
Romania are heavily favoured to defeat Iceland, who lost 2-0 to Lithuania at the weekend.
